prompt: How many price points does product 2 have? Every list price version of product 2 in price_history and every competitor price check of product 2 in competitor_prices is one price point, even when two of them have the same price. The answer has one column, price_points, in one row. Which query returns it?

options.text:
WITH p AS (
  SELECT list_price_eur AS price_eur FROM price_history WHERE product_id = 2
  UNION
  SELECT price_eur FROM competitor_prices WHERE product_id = 2
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS price_points FROM p

SELECT COUNT(*) AS price_points
FROM price_history ph
JOIN competitor_prices cp ON cp.product_id = ph.product_id
WHERE ph.product_id = 2

WITH p AS (
  SELECT list_price_eur AS price_eur FROM price_history WHERE product_id = 2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT price_eur FROM competitor_prices WHERE product_id = 2
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS price_points FROM p

WITH p AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT list_price_eur AS price_eur FROM price_history WHERE product_id = 2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DISTINCT price_eur FROM competitor_prices WHERE product_id = 2
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS price_points FROM p
